data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Why is the Lone Ranger nicknamed “Lone” though he is constantly accompanied by his Indian friend Tonto ASSISTANT:
The Lone Ranger is nicknamed "Lone" because he is a solitary figure who operates alone, with his companion Tonto being the only one who knows his true identity.
